messages:
Zoe: Quick poll — whats your morning beverage ritual? coffee / tea / water / nothing / other. Bonus: how long between wakeup and first sip?
Mike: coffee. black. first sip within 5 min. :coffee:
Emma: tea (green). usually after ~20 min, need to wake up fully. :tea:
Sanjay: water + lemon. glass on nightstand, drink immediately. coffee later at desk. :droplet: :coffee:
Laila: coffee, Aeropress. two-minute ritual, love the fiddliness. `Aeropress inverted`
coffee_bot: Daily caffeine reminder set for 09:30 AM :alarm_clock:
Zoe: Cool — vote by emoji: :coffee: = coffee, :tea: = tea, :droplet: = water, :zzz: = nothing, :question: = other
Mike: :coffee: counted
Emma: :tea:
Sanjay: :droplet:
Laila: :coffee: (but artisanal) :heart:
Alex: oat latte on the commute, usually ~15 min after waking.
Zoe: Tally so far: coffee 2, tea 1, water 1, other 1. Anyone have a weird/hilarious ritual? (singing to the kettle, making a tiny origami cup, etc.)
Mike: I whisper to my french press like its a fragile plant. dont @ me.
Sanjay: I have a 3-song playlist that only plays while I make coffee. its sacred.
Emma: I used to splash iced matcha into a travel mug in college. not my proudest morning.
Laila: If anyone wants my Aeropress recipe: 15g coffee / 240ml water / 1:16 ratio / 90s steep + plunge. happy to demo.
Zoe: Love it. Ill compile notes and put a tiny "morning rituals" board near the kitchen for posterity. :white_check_mark:
